title: This Animal Throws Out Its Own Guts to Escape, Then Regrows Them

scenes.text: This animal throws up its own guts to escape. Then regrows them.
When a sea cucumber is startled, it shoots out its intestines.
Sometimes along with other organs, out the mouth or the rear.
In about three weeks the gut is rebuilt. In two months it looks brand new.
Scientists still are not sure why. Maybe to scare off predators.

description:
A sea cucumber can eject its intestines and other organs when it is startled, then grow them back.
In one study, regrowth began within three days, the intestine was rebuilt in just over three weeks, and after about two months the new gut looked almost like the original. Scientists think the stunt may scare off predators.
Would you want to regrow an organ? Tell us.
